claude-pro.call_to_action: send you a payment link on SMS
claude-pro.pitch_hi: Claude Pro एक AI असिस्टेंट है जो लिखने, कोडिंग और रिसर्च में मदद करता है, और इसमें फ्री प्लान से कहीं ज़्यादा इस्तेमाल मिलता है।
claude-pro.pitch_hinglish: Claude Pro ek AI assistant hai jo likhne, coding aur research mein madad karta hai, aur isme free plan se kahin zyada usage milta hai.
claude-pro.pitch_en: Claude Pro is an AI assistant for writing, coding and research, with far more usage than the free plan.
claude-pro.knowledge: Claude is an AI assistant made by Anthropic. People use it by typing or talking to it to write and edit text, write and debug code, analyse documents and data, research topics and brainstorm. It works on the web (claude.ai), on iPhone and Android apps and on desktop. Claude Pro is the paid individual plan: much more usage than the free plan, access to more models, and Projects to keep documents and chats together. It is software, not a physical product; nothing is shipped. Limits: it cannot create images or videos (it can read and understand images, PDFs and files you upload); it needs the internet, there is no offline mode; it cannot make bookings, payments or phone calls for you. A Pro subscription is for one person's account and should not be shared; groups use the separate Team plan. Students, writers, developers and small businesses use it; it can explain homework step by step. This offer is for new Pro subscriptions: someone who already pays for Pro keeps their current plan and price, and someone on the free plan can take the offer. Many people use Claude alongside other assistants such as ChatGPT; people often pick Claude for careful writing, working with long documents and coding help. Coding: it explains problems step by step, helps debug, and can read long code files; good for practising DSA. It writes and edits reports and assignments and works in Hindi and many other languages. Privacy: Anthropic may use chats to improve its models only if the user allows it; each user chooses this in their privacy settings, and the full policy is at anthropic.com/privacy (say exactly this; do not claim it never uses data). Billing: there is also yearly billing that works out cheaper per month (exact price on the pricing page). There is no separate student discount in this offer; the discount already applies. Cancelling stops the next renewal and access continues until the end of the paid month; refunds follow the policy on the website. Anthropic is a real AI safety and research company, founded in 2021 and based in San Francisco, that makes Claude; the official site is anthropic.com. The payment page shows the payment methods; card works, and other methods depend on what the page shows (do not promise UPI or any specific method). The payment link comes by SMS to the number we called. Renewal: the subscription renews automatically every month; after the first 3 months it renews at $20 a month until the user cancels (say this plainly if asked whether money is taken automatically). Models: Pro includes Anthropic's latest Claude models, including the most capable Opus and the fast Sonnet; usage is roughly five times the free plan, counted in sessions that reset every five hours; the exact number of messages depends on their length, so there is no fixed message count (say so plainly). The $8 offer is only for the monthly plan. Yearly billing is listed at about $200 a year (about $17 a month) with no extra offer; Team plan prices are on the website. The SMS with the link usually arrives within a couple of minutes and opens Anthropic's official claude.ai page. Receipts and invoices for each payment are available in the account's billing settings. For a shop or small business it helps: GST calculations, bill formats, lists of dues (udhaari), and drafting WhatsApp or SMS messages to customers (it writes them, the user sends them); the user should check the numbers. Tally (टैली/टेली) is accounting software; Claude is not a replacement for Tally, but helps alongside it. OTP: on the payment page the user's own bank may send an OTP to approve the payment; it must never be shared with anyone, including this call. If an existing subscriber asks whether cancelling and signing up again with a new account would get the offer: you don't know that and must not promise it. Colleagues or friends who don't have Pro yet can each take this offer on their own account. The SMS comes from Anthropic, not from a bank, and the link opens Anthropic's own claude.ai payment page. Never suggest making another account or email to get the offer, and never claim what is or isn't allowed for second accounts; you can't confirm those rules. If asked where we got their number: you don't have details of the list's source; offer to remove the number.

fitzone-gym.pitch_en: FitZone is a gym with trainers and yoga and zumba classes, open from 5 in the morning to 11 at night.
fitzone-gym.knowledge: FitZone is a neighbourhood gym chain (demo product). Membership includes gym floor access, cardio and weights, group classes (yoga, zumba, HIIT), one free personal trainer session per week, lockers and showers. Members can freeze the membership for up to 15 days. There is no joining fee in this offer. Equipment: cardio machines (treadmills, cycles, cross-trainers), free weights (dumbbells, barbells, plates), benches for bench press, a squat rack, cable machines and leg press. Personal training beyond the one free session a week is charged separately; the exact rate is shown at the front desk (never invent a price). Joining: open the link sent by SMS or walk into the nearest branch; the trainer does a free fitness assessment on day one.
